svg.title: Quality against the encoder's own noise
svg.desc: Mean SSIM of each GPU path against a near-lossless reference, next to the noise floor: the same reference re-encoded by the path's encoder with nothing else changed. Every path lands within 0.008 of its floor; most within 0.002.
svg.text: Quality against the encoder's own noise
Mean SSIM against a near-lossless reference (PNG capture, ProRes 4444 XQ).
Tick: the reference re-encoded by the same encoder, nothing else changed. Dot: the path.

g.text: Worst single frame: 0.958 (R, layers: another 25 fps source frame picked). VMAF was not available.
R whole, dedup: the floor is a second run of layers without dedup (whole video).
